title: Challenge a friend
summary: Sharing is reframed as a challenge: the share text opens with "Dáte víc než 483 bodů?", the ticket asks "Překonáte mě?" in red, the section heading and main button read "Vyzvěte kamarády" / "Vyzvat kamarády", and the link goes to /hra/<date> so friends get the same question.
tradeoffs: The share text drops the separate score line (the score is in the opening question); the competitive tone may not suit every player.
